_comment: Scoped to the trading instance only -- Claude Code discovers this by walking up from each role's cwd (trading/roles/<role>/). If your Claude Code version doesn't expand $HERMES_REPO_ROOT, hardcode the absolute path to the server scripts on the VPS instead. Only the Analyst role has these tools in --allowedTools (see hermes/orchestrator.py ROLE_ALLOWED_TOOLS) -- registering a server here does not by itself grant any role access to it.
